question.text: An intermediary that uses AI and ML tools procured from third-party technology providers is responsible for:

answer.text: Only the privacy, security and integrity of investors' data
Only the output arising from the usage of such tools
The privacy, security and integrity of investors' data; the output arising from usage of such tools; and compliance with applicable laws

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 6.7 and Regulation 16C, any person regulated by SEBI that uses AI/ML tools is solely responsible for the privacy, security and integrity of investors' data, the output arising from such usage, and compliance with applicable laws. The Trap: Each narrower option lists a real responsibility but only one slice of it. The regulation places sole responsibility for all three areas on the regulated entity, not the third-party vendor. Note: Rewrote the keyed option as a standalone enumerated list (no "All of the above") so the question remains correct under answer randomization, and removed the unsupported pro-tip paragraph.
